test_pickle_simple_callable: test pickling a simple callable bound from C++ via pybind11 and verify roundtrip serialization
test_roundtrip_pickleable: test roundtrip pickling of Pickleable and PickleableNew classes using pickle protocol 2 or higher
test_roundtrip_with_dict: test roundtrip pickling of PickleableWithDict classes that support dynamic __dict__ attributes
test_enum_pickle: test pickling and unpickling of a pybind11-bound C++ enum value EOne
test_roundtrip_simple_py_derived: test roundtrip pickling of a Python class derived from a pybind11 C++ base class SimpleBase
